name: Mediterranean "Grinder Sandwich" with Chickpeas, Marinated Veggies & Feta Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Place mayo, vinegar, oil, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ green bell pepper
½ English cucumber
1 heart romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Drain roasted peppers and artichokes, then roughly chop into small pieces. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (340 g) jar roasted red bell peppers
½ (106 g) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop chickpeas. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Gently open up the sub rolls (making sure to keep one side attached), then arrange on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, fill toasted rolls with grinder salad and arrange on a platter. Enjoy!
